steps.code:
# Calculate mean and median mpg for each of the top 3 displacement values
results = []

for displacement in top_3_displacements:
    # Filter data for this displacement value
    mpg_for_displacement = df[df['displacement'] == displacement]['mpg']
    
    # Calculate mean and median
    mean_mpg = mpg_for_displacement.mean()
    median_mpg = mpg_for_displacement.median()
    
    # Round to 2 decimal places
    mean_mpg_rounded = round(mean_mpg, 2)
    median_mpg_rounded = round(median_mpg, 2)
    
    results.append((displacement, mean_mpg_rounded, median_mpg_rounded))
    
    print(f"Displacement: {displacement}")
    print(f"  Mean MPG: {mean_mpg_rounded}")
    print(f"  Median MPG: {median_mpg_rounded}")
    print(f"  Count: {len(mpg_for_displacement)}")
    print()

# Format the answer as required
answer_lines = []
for i, (displacement, mean_val, median_val) in enumerate(results, 1):
    answer_lines.append(f"@mean{i}[{mean_val}], @median{i}[{median_val}]")

answer_string = "\n".join(answer_lines)
print("Final Answer:")
print(answer_string)
